components.note: 甘 (sweet) — marks sweetness, as in 甘 itself and 某; 甜 pairs it with 舌 tongue: sweet to the tongue.
舌 (tongue) — the organ that tastes, as in 话 and 活.
里 (village, land) — in 野 it means land: open country beyond the village, wild, as in 野兽.
予 (yǔ) hints at the sound: 野 yě is close to 预 yù and 序 xù.
木 (tree) — marks trees and plants, as in 树, 林, 村; 植 is to plant.
直 (zhí) gives the sound exactly: 植 zhí, also in 值 zhí and 殖 zhí.
曼 (màn) — long, graceful; as a part it sounds out 慢 màn, 漫 màn, 馒 mán and 蔓 màn.
方 (fāng) hints at the sound: 妨 fáng is close to 防 fáng and 房 fáng, which share it.
巫 — shaman: a ritual tool 工 with two figures 人 dancing on either side. 巫 wū also sounds out 诬 wū.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth and coverings, as in 布, 帽, 带; decorating was often done with cloth.
饣 (here from 食 shí) is the sound part: 饰 shì is close.
写 (xiě) — to write; as a part it sounds out 泻 xiè (to flow out).
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 撤 is to pull away. The right side matches old 徹 (now 彻 chè), which gave the sound.
女 (woman) — marks women, as in 妈, 姐, 好; 姓 first meant the clan traced through mothers.
生 (shēng) hints at the sound: 姓 xìng is close to 性 xìng and 星 xīng, which share it.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海; 沿 is to go along a stream's edge, hence to follow.
忄 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 情, 怕, 悲; 惨 is a wretched, painful feeling.
参 (cān) gives the sound: 惨 cǎn is close, as in 掺 chān.
瓦 (tile, pottery) — marks pottery and fired clay, as in 瓷 china; 瓶 is a bottle.
并 (bìng) hints at the sound: 瓶 píng is close to 拼 pīn and 屏 píng.
彳 (step) — marks walking, as in 行, 往, 很, 得; 徒 pairs it with 走 walk: going on foot, then a follower.
走 (walk) — as in 跑 run, 起 rise.
心 (heart) — marks the mind and feelings, as in 想, 思, 意; 忽 is a lapse of attention, hence neglect or suddenly.
勿 (wù) is a loose hint for hū; 物 wù shares it.
隹 (short-tailed bird) — marks birds, as in 难, 谁 (loan uses), 集; 雅 first named a crow, now borrowed for 'elegant'.
牙 (yá) hints at the sound: 雅 yǎ is close to 鸦 yā and 呀 ya.
土 (earth) — marks soil and dust, as in 地, 城, 墙; 埃 is fine dust.
矣 (yǐ) is a loose hint for āi; 唉 āi and 挨 āi share the part.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth, as in 布, 带, 帽; 幕 is a curtain or screen.
莫 (mò) hints at the sound: 幕 mù is close to 墓 mù, 慕 mù and 暮 mù.
页 (head) — marks the head and face, as in 顶, 题, 顺; 额 is the forehead, then an amount.
客 (kè) is a loose hint for é; 格 gé and 路 lù share it.
冫 (ice) — marks cold and reduction, as in 冰, 冷, 冻; 减 is to lessen.
咸 (xián) hints at the sound: 减 jiǎn is close to 感 gǎn, 喊 hǎn and 碱 jiǎn.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 挽 is to pull or draw back.
免 (miǎn) hints at the sound: 挽 wǎn is close to 晚 wǎn.
酉 (wine jar) — marks liquor, as in 酒, 醉, 醒; 酗 is drunken rowdiness.
凶 (xiōng) hints at the sound: 酗 xù is close; 凶 also means fierce.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and trade, as in 财, 货, 贵; 贷 is to lend or borrow.
代 (dài) gives the sound exactly: 贷 dài, also in 袋 dài.
欠 (open mouth, owe) — marks wanting and owing, as in 歌, 欢, 欲; 款 is a sum owed or paid.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 胆 is the gall bladder, then courage.
旦 (dàn) hints at the sound: 胆 dǎn is close to 担 dān and 但 dàn.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wood, as in 林, 树, 桥; 柏 is a cypress.
白 (bái) hints at the sound: 柏 bǎi/bó is close to 百 bǎi and 伯 bó.
犭 (animal) — marks animals, as in 狗, 猫, 猪; 狠 is a fierce, dog-like cruelty.
艮 (gèn) hints at the sound: 狠 hěn is close to 很 hěn and 恨 hèn.
戈 (halberd) — marks weapons and fighting, as in 战, 成, 我; 戚 was a kind of axe, later borrowed for relatives (亲戚).
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 拼 is to put together.
并 (bìng) hints at the sound: 拼 pīn is close to 瓶 píng, which shares it.
木 (wood) — marks trees and wood, as in 林, 树, 桥; 枕 was a wooden pillow.
冘 (yín) is a loose hint for zhěn; 沉 chén shares it.
旧 (simplified 舊) — old; the old sound part 臼 (jiù) also gives 舅 jiù (uncle).
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 操 is to handle or drill.
喿 (zào) hints at the sound: 操 cāo is close to 澡 zǎo and 燥 zào.
户 (door) — marks doors and houses, as in 房, 所, 扇; 屏 is a screen set before a door.
并 (bìng) hints at the sound: 屏 píng is close to 瓶 píng.
番 (fān) — a turn, to take turns; as a part it sounds out 翻 fān, 潘 pān and 播 bō.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and gifts, as in 财, 货, 贵; 贡 is tribute presented.
工 (gōng) gives the sound: 贡 gòng is close, as in 功 gōng and 红 hóng.
犬 (dog) — a sacrifice was offered with a dog, hence 献 is to present or offer; the left side is a simplified stand-in.
王 (jade, 玉旁) — marks jade and gems, as in 球, 珠, 玩; 琼 is fine jade.
京 (jīng) is only a loose sound hint for qióng.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness and pain, as in 病, 痛, 疼; 疚 is the ache of guilt, as in 内疚.
久 (jiǔ) hints at the sound: 疚 jiù is close.
艹 (plants) — marks plants, as in 花, 草, 菜; 荡 is to sway or wash about.
汤 (tāng) stands in for the old part 昜 that also sounds out 场 chǎng, 扬 yáng and 烫 tàng.
革 (leather) — marks hides, as in 鞋 shoe, 鞭 whip, 革命; 靴 is a boot.
化 (huà) is a loose hint for xuē; 花 huā and 货 huò share it.
车 (cart, vehicle) — marks wheeled things, as in 转, 轮, 较; 辆 counts vehicles.
两 (liǎng) hints at the sound: 辆 liàng is close.
女 (woman) — marks women and girls, as in 妈, 姐, 好; 妮 is a young girl, often in names.
尼 (ní) gives the sound: 妮 nī is close, as in 泥 ní.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and trade, as in 财, 货, 贵; 账 is an account or bill.
长 (zhǎng) hints at the sound: 账 zhàng is close to 胀 zhàng and 帐 zhàng.
丰 — a picture of lush growing grain or grass: plenty, as in 丰富.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 插 is to stick in.
臿 (chā) gives the sound exactly: 插 chā.
口 (mouth) — marks speech and exclamations, as in 啊, 呀, 哦; 哎 is a cry of surprise.
艾 (ài) hints at the sound: 哎 āi is close.
口 (mouth) — marks speech and exclamations, as in 啊, 哎, 哦; 呀 is a soft particle.
牙 (yá) hints at the sound: 呀 ya is close to 芽 yá and 鸦 yā.
忄 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 情, 快, 怕; 慷 is generous feeling (慷慨).
康 (kāng) gives the sound exactly: 慷 kāng.
忄 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 情, 快, 怕; 慨 is a sigh or stirring of feeling (慷慨).
既 (jì) is a loose hint for kǎi; 概 gài and 溉 gài share it.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海, 游; 潜 is to dive under the water, hence hidden, as in 潜水.
